fields.Name: T303 - New Communication Audience Source Picker
fields.Description: Covers the embedded mj-audience-source-picker control and the conditional recipient-field reveal (@if audienceSource) — a compose-only affordance absent elsewhere.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its New Communication (New Message) section. Look at the 'Audience' panel on the right. Success = the audience-source picker renders, offering ways to target recipients (such as a List, a saved View, or an ad-hoc filter); if you select a source, a 'Recipient field' text input appears beneath the picker with its helper hint. Seeing the picker render its source options is success — you do NOT need to actually pick real data. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Audience panel renders an audience-source picker with selectable source-type options (List / View / ad-hoc)
Choosing a source reveals the 'Recipient field' input (or the picker clearly renders its options even if no source is chosen)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
